title: PM Modi Launches South India's First Semiconductor Chip Plant in Visakhapatnam
summary: Establishes domestic semiconductor packaging hubs under India Semiconductor Mission.

blocks.content: Establishes domestic semiconductor packaging hubs under India Semiconductor Mission.

items:
📌 **Core Policy Directives & Scope:**
PM laid foundation stone for **ASIP Technologies's ₹2,500 crore** OSAT facility.
Location: **Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh**.

💰 **Financial Outlays & Operational Rules:**
Regional Milestone: **Andhra Pradesh's and South India's 1st semiconductor plant** under ISM 1.0.
Tech Partner: **APACT Co.** (South Korea).

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: India Semiconductor Mission (ISM) launched 2021 under MeitY (outlay ₹76,000 crore).

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: South India's 1st OSAT plant (ASIP Visakhapatnam, AP) vs India's 1st Commercial Fab (Tata Dholera, Gujarat).
